name: No One of Consequence
source:
Alone, restrained, and at his mercy, you learn quickly: this isn’t a game of luck. It’s a game of endurance.

[From [url=https://jumper-insectia.itch.io/no-one-of-consequence]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
孤立无援、手脚受缚、任他摆布的你很快便会明白：这不是一场凭运气定胜负的游戏，而是一场比拼忍耐力的考验。

[摘自[url=https://jumper-insectia.itch.io/no-one-of-consequence]itch.io[/url]]
